source_refs.note: Exercise 13.2, Question 3: differentiate a quotient that simplifies by factorising (book p.255). The answer key (PDF 311) gives an equivalent unsimplified form.

blocks.explanation:
Yeh Sawal 2 ka bhai hai: lamba quotient jo pehle simplify ho jata hai.
Humein derivative find karna hai.
Is dafa neeche bhi factorise hoga: \(x^{3/2} - x^{1/2} = \sqrt{x}(x - 1)\).
Plan: upar cubes ka farq, neeche common factor aur squares ka farq, cancel, phir power rule.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(y = \dfrac{(\sqrt{x} + 1)(x^{3/2} - 1)}{x^{3/2} - x^{1/2}}\), \(x > 0\), \(x \ne 1\) (warna neeche zero).
Humein find karna hai: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).
Tareeqa: Factorise kar ke cancel, phir power rule. Pehle simplify karna yahan sab se bara time saver hai.

Neeche wala factorise karein
\[x^{3/2} - x^{1/2} = x^{1/2}(x - 1)\]
\[= \sqrt{x}(\sqrt{x} - 1)(\sqrt{x} + 1)\]
Kyun: Dono terms mein \(x^{1/2}\) common hai: \(x^{1/2} \cdot x = x^{3/2}\). Phir \(x - 1 = (\sqrt{x})^2 - 1^2 = (\sqrt{x} - 1)(\sqrt{x} + 1)\), squares ka farq.

Upar wala factorise karein
\[x^{3/2} - 1 = (\sqrt{x} - 1)(x + \sqrt{x} + 1)\]
Kyun: Cubes ka farq \(a^3 - b^3 = (a - b)(a^2 + ab + b^2)\), jahan \(a = \sqrt{x}\), \(b = 1\), bilkul Sawal 2 ki tarah.

Cancel kar ke tor dein
\[y = \dfrac{x + \sqrt{x} + 1}{\sqrt{x}}\]
\[= x^{1/2} + 1 + x^{-1/2}\]
Kyun: Upar aur neeche dono mein \((\sqrt{x} + 1)\) aur \((\sqrt{x} - 1)\) hain; yeh zero nahi (kyunke \(x > 0\), \(x \ne 1\)), is liye cancel ho gaye. Phir har term ko \(\sqrt{x}\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{x}} = \sqrt{x}\), \(\frac{\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{x}} = 1\), \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} = x^{-1/2}\).

Differentiate karein
\[\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{2}x^{-1/2} - \frac{1}{2}x^{-3/2}\]
\[= \dfrac{x - 1}{2x\sqrt{x}}\]
Kyun: Power rule: \(x^{1/2} \to \frac{1}{2}x^{-1/2}\), 1 ka derivative zero, \(x^{-1/2} \to -\frac{1}{2}x^{-3/2}\). Common denominator \(2x^{3/2}\) lene ke liye pehli term ko upar neeche \(x\) se guna kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(-\frac{1}{2} - 1 = -\frac{3}{2}\) hai; power ka hisaab dhyan se.

Answer key se muqabla
\[\dfrac{x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1}{2\sqrt{x}(x^{3/2} - x^{1/2})^2} = \dfrac{(x - 1)^3}{2\sqrt{x} \cdot x(x - 1)^2}\]
\[= \dfrac{x - 1}{2x\sqrt{x}}\]
Kyun: Key ka numerator \((x - 1)^3\) ka expansion hai, aur \((x^{3/2} - x^{1/2})^2 = x(x - 1)^2\). Cancel karne par bilkul humara jawab aata hai; key ne simplify nahi kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{At } x = 4:\ \frac{3}{16} = 0.1875\]
\[\frac{y(4.001) - y(3.999)}{0.002} \approx 0.1875\]
Kyun: \(x = 4\) par numerical slope bhi 0.1875 hai, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x - 1}{2x\sqrt{x}}\) (answer key ki shakal \(\frac{x^3 - 3x^2 + 3x - 1}{2\sqrt{x}(x^{3/2} - x^{1/2})^2}\) ke barabar)
